## Reproduced helper defect with exact CLI call-site evidence

PR #170 source `38c33adbb232d441be43bbec1dbe3e0a2513afbd`, unchanged in current `ca2b52c63f2d8432157dd6643844ce748b237085`; Node 24.22.1, isolated exact params.ts. No real credential, live provider or tracker mutation. Not a released-version or complete CLI reproduction.

The dry-run output at [shared.ts:454](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-presets/blob/ca2b52c63f2d8432157dd6643844ce748b237085/src/presets/shared.ts#L454) serializes settings before calling the raw-string redactor:

```js
const synthetic = 'synthetic"marker';
const output = redactSecretValues(JSON.stringify({token: synthetic}, null, 2), [synthetic]);
JSON.parse(output).token === synthetic; // true: value remains recoverable
```

JSON escapes the quote, so the serialized text does not contain the unescaped raw string. The redactor's split/join therefore leaves it intact. Quote and backslash values are valid ordinary strings under the parameter contract; no control character is needed.

The [accepted feature record](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-presets/blob/ca2b52c63f2d8432157dd6643844ce748b237085/.agents/pm/features/pm-qz1k.toon) explicitly requires secrets never enter emitted output, including dry-run patches. The expected result is a redacted value; actual helper output contains a reversible serialization of the input.

Impact: a dry-run JSON dump can expose a secret-typed value in logs or agent output despite its privacy-safe guarantee. This is an unreleased PR finding; actual user disclosure is not claimed.

Acceptance/regression criteria:
- Redact secret-bearing structured values before serialization, or otherwise cover JSON encoding without losing the complete capability of valid input strings.
- Add synthetic quote/backslash and combined-escape regressions for the actual dry-run output and every serialized diff output.
- Assert neither raw nor reversibly JSON-encoded synthetic values survive; keep ordinary text redaction and default secret refusal.
- Re-run real CLI/SDK consumers on the final head; preserve pre-write refusal and input immutability.

All 172 all-status issue/PR records, current PR conversation/inline collections and canonical feature record checked. Existing #171 is a separate normalization defect. Full CLI/build/integration coverage remains untested here.
